subject: Mobile Development
title: The Razr: Design as Desire
description: A 60-second lesson on The Razr: Design as Desire.

hook.text: In 2004, Motorola unveiled the Razr V3 — the thinnest flip phone ever made.

buildup.text: At just 13.9 millimeters thick, it looked like a razor blade. The design was stunning.

discovery.text: It sold over 130 million units, making it the best-selling flip phone in history.

twist.text: Motorola focused so much on the Razr sequel that it missed the smartphone transition entirely.

climax.text: The Razr showed that industrial design could drive phone sales — but design alone wasn't enough.

punchline.text: The coolest flip phone missed the next era.

quiz.question: How many Razr V3 units were sold?
